exposure: Genetic variants (specifically ABCB5 c.1610G>A; p.Arg537His variant)
cohort: The study included a multi-generational family (proband and five female relatives) with recurrent hepatobiliary disease and a control group of 433 unrelated women with uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: A rare heterozygous missense variant in ABCB5 (c.1610G>A; p.Arg537His) was identified, segregating with ICP and early-onset hepatobiliary disease within the family, suggesting ABCB5 as a potential new susceptibility gene.
